newsitem.title: CYPRUS: OPEC Jan output 26.55 million bpd -MEES.
newsitem.headline: OPEC Jan output 26.55 million bpd -MEES.

text.p: Iraqi exports pushed OPEC crude oil production up by 390,000 barrels a day (bpd) in January to 26.55 million bpd, the Middle East Economic Survey (MEES) said on Monday.
"As expected, the January increase in OPEC output was largely attributable to a programmed increment in Iraqi crude oil exports under the U.N. oil-for-food plan," it said.

"MEES estimates that Iraqi crude oil exports under the U.N. programme reached some 520,000 bpd in January in addition to 580,000 bpd for domestic consumption and special-status exports to Jordan -- making a total of 1.1 million bpd for the month, an increase of 300,000 bpd over the December average of 800,000 bpd," the newsletter said.
A Reuters survey put OPEC January ouput at 26.64 million bpd. The 11-member group has an official ceiling of 25.033 million bpd.
MEES said Iran's crude output is estimated to have increased by 105,000 bpd to 3.705 million bpd in January, with exports rising to 2.505 million bpd.
